explanation: Taste buds all over the tongue can sense every basic taste. The famous tongue map grew out of a misreading of a German study published in 1901.

claims.text: The tongue is not divided into zones for different tastes: taste buds across the tongue detect all the basic tastes.
Taste buds all over the tongue can detect every basic taste.
The tongue map came from a misinterpretation of a German study by David Hänig, published in 1901.
